ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates the central field; low-intensity black is confined to peripheral edges and specific trailing edge streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white region occupies the central 80% of fluke area. Black pigment forms a continuous band along the trailing edge with distinct vertical 'bleed' patterns on the right lobe extending toward the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression at the center with a narrow, acute angle and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extensive serration along the entire trailing edge boundary. The left lobe contains broader, more irregular jagged segments; the right lobe contains sharper, more uniform tooth-like variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a prominent convex outward curve; the right lobe shows a more linear, elongated sweep towards the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark clusters localized on the outer lateral boundary of the left lobe lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Small horizontal linear mark in the mid-left lobe; several thin vertical black streaks near the median notch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregular indentations and tears along the trailing edges of both lobes, specifically a deep notch on the left inner lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined vertical black pigmentation streaks on the right inner lobe creating a high-contrast 'comb' appearance.
